title: Let's work together
description: I build digital products end to end and can work wherever the problem calls for it, across frontend, backend, mobile applications, or solutions that use AI.

availability.title: Current availability
availability.intro: I do not keep a public availability calendar. I prefer to understand the context, the stage of the project, and where my experience can be useful first.
availability.longTerm: Long-term collaborations: open to a conversation
availability.freelance: Freelance projects: considered based on context, scope, and timeline

contributions.title: Where I can contribute
contributions.ai: Products and solutions that use AI
contributions.architecture: Product architecture, evolution, and technical quality
contributions.description: I have a generalist profile and can adapt to different technologies and forms of collaboration. The starting point is usually the problem that needs to be solved.

start.title: How to start
start.description: Send a message with your details, the kind of collaboration you are looking for, and a short summary of the context.
start.alternative: If you prefer, reach me directly by email or LinkedIn.

form.placeholderMessage: Tell me about the problem, the stage of the project, and how you think I could contribute.
